# 4 bed semi-detached house for sale

> Discover contemporary living in the heart of Crossmolina with this exceptional A-rated home, ideally positioned within a newly constructed development just a short stroll from the town centre. Finished to an impressive standard throughout, this beautifully designed property combines timeless Georgian-inspired architecture, elegant sash windows and quality craftsmanship.
